raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The line chart compares the performance of three different methods, labeled as lattice, FLAT, and OURS, over a series of epochs. The x-axis represents the number of epochs, ranging from 0 to 18, while the y-axis measures the F1 score, ranging from 0.55 to 0.90. The lattice method, represented by a red line with square markers, shows a steady increase in performance, starting at an F1 score of approximately 0.60 and reaching about 0.85 by the 18th epoch. The FLAT method, indicated by a blue line with circle markers, begins with an F1 score around 0.70 and ends with a score close to 0.90. The OURS method, depicted by a yellow line with triangle markers, starts at an F1 score near 0.80 and concludes with a score just below 0.90. All three methods show an upward trend, indicating improvement in performance as the number of epochs increases.
